div.p: I have received and read the Innovations Code of Conduct and the policy on Anti-sexual harassment initiative. I understand the policies and standards contained therein. I acknowledge that as a resource employed at Ekara Partnership and its subsidiaries or divisions it is my obligation to abide by the Business Conduct guidelines in line with employment conditions as specified in Appointment letter.

I understand that I should report any possible violation of the Code of Conduct and raise any question or concern through discussion with the line manager/ human resource representative /Business Head of the unit or through the Innovations Group HR.
I understand Innovations reserves the right to introduce and modify code of conduct guidelines from time to time which will be updated on GPM/Portal regularly for reference.

I further understand that my failure to comply with the policies and standards contained in the Business Code of Conduct may lead to disciplinary action up to and including possible termination of my assignment/ deputation.
